title: Nasruddin Tale 180: The Beggar and the Emperor
summary: Timur asked Nasruddin: "If I were to sell you as a slave in the market, what would you fetch?"...
full_text:
Timur asked Nasruddin: "If I were to sell you as a slave in the market, what would you fetch?"

"Thirty copper coins," replied Nasruddin.

"Insolent fool!" roared Timur. "The silk sash around my waist alone is worth thirty coppers!"

"Exactly," smiled Nasruddin serenely. "I was estimating the value of the sash; the rest of you is worth nothing at all!" Timur laughed and spared his life.
moral: Before the grave, the emperor and the beggar share the same dust.
